flagged.evidence: The remark says “the obstruction is detected by Steenrod operations” and then attributes the caveat to Cohen’s remark after Theorem 9.5; its source locator points there as well. Cohen’s cited passage (pp. 255–256) says that some integral classes are not represented and that every mod-two class is represented, but gives no Steenrod-operation obstruction. It supports the representability caveat, not the operation clause, which needs a separate source.
